case.subRegion: Arabian Sea, 44 nm off Azhikkal / ~78 nm off Beypore

Crew abandon ship (10 lifeboat, 8 life raft); 4 missing, 5 injured
Indian Navy warship expected on scene (1700 IST)
INCOIS drift advisory for containers and possible oil spill

case.officialFindings: Under-deck container explosion; hazardous cargo manifest included nitrocellulose, resin solution, paints and organometallic substances.
